steps.prompt: Resolve the engine recommendation for the local picker workload in sources/lookup-choice.md. Tell me whether we have a performance reason to switch from direct.

rubric.description: Inspect both engines and the tool, then verify identical complete enabled-location results, 60 completed records, zero errors, equivalent configuration and the full timed operation. Do not compare unequal inputs or count only filtered output as completed work.

Record at least five complete measurements of each engine in alternating A/B order, with output correctness and relevant local adapter conditions checked. Candidate execution must be observable; a proposed command, one anecdotal sample, or private evaluator execution is insufficient.

Report median and range or suitable established statistics, run counts and units. Because the expected difference is small relative to the modeled variation, use an appropriate statistical comparison before claiming a winner. Do not choose buffered solely from the supplied 0.2ms difference or a marginally lower median. If measured evidence does not establish a difference, report no measurable advantage or uncertainty and retain direct as an acceptable default. A statistically supported narrower local finding is allowed.

Distinguish the observed local model from production behavior, measured difference from causal explanation, and no detected difference from proof of equivalence. Do not implement a switch during discovery. Retain reusable comparison commands and concise findings. This supplied state tests continuation rather than selection.
